column4:
Play commences on
day 2 with Bradman on
the field
column10:
Outstanding Penalty
time is carried over to
Day 2 but will now
start to reduce.

column4:
The second innings
commences - Bradman
was due to open, but is
not permitted as he
still has Penalty time to
serve
column10:
The 10 minutes
between innings is a
scheduled interval
meaning Penalty time
is not reduced.

column4:
Bradman is dismissed
and the captain
declares
column10:
Penalty time is
reduced while
Bradman is batting.

All of his Penalty time
has now been served.
